title: Include the ticket ID in every commit message that closes a task
body: Peer reviewers use automated scripts to search git logs by ticket ID. A commit implementing SC-054 but named only 'fix photo layout' will fail peer review even if the code is correct. At minimum one commit must include the ticket ID verbatim.
